tasks.subject: Task 1: Add quiet-capture mechanism to ScriptDiagnosticCapture
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `ScriptDiagnosticCapture::start(true)` suppresses stderr printing of subsequently captured diagnostics while still recording them as events; `start()`/`start(false)` unchanged.

**Files:**
- Modify: core/object/script_diagnostic_capture.h
- Modify: core/object/script_diagnostic_capture.cpp
- Test: tests/core/object/test_script_diagnostic_capture.h

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] start(bool p_quiet = false) exists; is_quiet() exists and reflects whether the currently active capture is quiet.
- [ ] Quiet capture sets CoreGlobals::print_error_enabled = false for its duration, restores exact prior value on stop().
- [ ] Non-quiet capture never touches CoreGlobals::print_error_enabled.
- [ ] Diagnostics still recorded as events regardless of quiet mode.

**Verify:** ./bin/godot.* --test --test-case="*ScriptDiagnosticCapture*" --force-colors

See docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-02-quiet-diagnostic-capture.md Task 1 for full code.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["core/object/script_diagnostic_capture.h", "core/object/script_diagnostic_capture.cpp", "tests/core/object/test_script_diagnostic_capture.h"], "verifyCommand": "./bin/godot.* --test --test-case=\"*ScriptDiagnosticCapture*\" --force-colors", "acceptanceCriteria": ["start(bool p_quiet = false) exists; is_quiet() exists", "Quiet capture toggles CoreGlobals::print_error_enabled and restores exact prior value", "Non-quiet capture never touches print_error_enabled", "Diagnostics still recorded as events regardless of quiet mode"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Regression-test quiet-capture composition
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Prove the ref-counted, engine-wide-while-any-quiet-capture-is-active behavior, including correct restoration when print_error_enabled was already false, and both nesting orders (quiet-in-loud, loud-in-quiet).

**Files:**
- Test: tests/core/object/test_script_diagnostic_capture.h

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Two overlapping quiet captures keep printing suppressed until the last one stops.
- [ ] A quiet capture started while printing was already disabled leaves it disabled afterward.
- [ ] A non-quiet capture nested inside an active quiet capture does not re-enable printing.
- [ ] A quiet capture nested inside an active non-quiet capture only suppresses for its own duration.

**Verify:** ./bin/godot.* --test --test-case="*ScriptDiagnosticCapture*" --force-colors

See docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-02-quiet-diagnostic-capture.md Task 2 for full code.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["tests/core/object/test_script_diagnostic_capture.h"], "verifyCommand": "./bin/godot.* --test --test-case=\"*ScriptDiagnosticCapture*\" --force-colors", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Overlapping quiet captures compose via ref count", "Restore precedence honors prior disabled state", "Both nesting orders (quiet-in-loud, loud-in-quiet) covered"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Regression-test fatal-diagnostic process isolation
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Document via tests that a captured fatal diagnostic never triggers OS::request_exit, and that quiet mode suppresses its stderr output like any other captured diagnostic.

**Files:**
- Modify: tests/core/variant/test_variant_utility.h
- Modify: tests/core/object/test_script_diagnostic_capture.h

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] New case in `[VariantUtility] push_fatal decision logic` proves active capture prevents exit request even with application/run/push_fatal_terminates enabled.
- [ ] New ScriptDiagnosticCapture test proves quiet capture suppresses stderr for a captured fatal diagnostic while still recording it.

**Verify:** ./bin/godot.* --test --test-case="*VariantUtility*push_fatal*" --test-case="*ScriptDiagnosticCapture*" --force-colors

See docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-02-quiet-diagnostic-capture.md Task 3 for full code.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["tests/core/variant/test_variant_utility.h", "tests/core/object/test_script_diagnostic_capture.h"], "verifyCommand": "./bin/godot.* --test --test-case=\"*VariantUtility*push_fatal*\" --test-case=\"*ScriptDiagnosticCapture*\" --force-colors", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Active capture prevents push_fatal exit request regression test", "Quiet capture suppresses stderr for captured fatal diagnostic"]}
```
